Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class CvdMaterialBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.CvdMaterialBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CvdMaterialBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, EOS-independent component accounting for an isothermal gas-condensate CVD experiment.

The first observation is the saturated, all-vapor reference with zero withdrawal and zero liquid volume. Each later observation describes the cell AFTER vapor withdrawal restores that same reference volume. The withdrawn vapor has that stage's equilibrium vapor composition; cumulative production is moles per initial mole, not standard gas volume. Liquid volume is a fraction of the initial saturated cell volume; do not substitute a pre-withdrawal fraction or reservoir liquid saturation. These are the Whitson-Torp CVD material-balance conventions (JPT 1983, DOI 10.2118/10067-PA). No separator conversion, EOS flash, smoothing, normalization or parameter fitting is performed.

Negative inventories and unresolved liquid amounts are retained as failed diagnostics. A zero/vanishing liquid amount never supplies an invented composition. Bounds on an optional final liquid analysis are caller-specified absolute mole-fraction differences; they are not inferred sigmas or propagated measurement uncertainty. Passing arithmetic does not establish measured accuracy, sample validity, critical behavior or laboratory-to-field qualification. This opt-in operation adds no work to ordinary simulation paths.

  • Constructor Details

    • CvdMaterialBalance

      public CvdMaterialBalance(String sampleReference, String experimentReference, String dataUseReference, double temperatureK, String[] componentNames, CvdMaterialBalance.Observation[] observations, double balanceTolerance, double minimumLiquidMoles, CvdMaterialBalance.FinalLiquidAnalysis finalAnalysis)
      Freezes the complete experiment and reconstructs all inventories on a one-initial-mole basis.
      Parameters:
      sampleReference - immutable sample/composition revision identity
      experimentReference - whole experiment, protocol and source/page/table reference
      dataUseReference - public access, data-use provenance and any source adjustments
      temperatureK - constant cell temperature in K
      componentNames - unique component identities in every composition array's order
      observations - saturated reference followed by strictly decreasing absolute pressures
      balanceTolerance - nonnegative absolute inventory tolerance in mol per initial mol, less than one
      minimumLiquidMoles - minimum resolved liquid amount, greater than balanceTolerance and at most one
      finalAnalysis - optional separately identified final liquid analysis; null makes no measured comparison
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs are missing, structurally invalid or arithmetic is unrepresentable
